create_HelloRequest: create a HelloRequest protobuf message with a name field for gRPC calls
create_HelloReply: create a HelloReply protobuf message with a message field for gRPC responses
use_Greeter_SayHello: use the Greeter service SayHello RPC method to send a HelloRequest and get a HelloReply
inspect_DESCRIPTOR: inspect the helloworld.proto file descriptor to list all message types and services
register_HelloRequest: register the HelloRequest message type with the protobuf symbol database
